reply.emotion: satisfied and relieved, checking the account balance on payday
notes: Sueldo usually refers to a regular monthly salary paid to a salaried employee, whereas 'salario' can sometimes sound a bit more technical or general.

senses.definition: Dinero regular que recibe una persona por su trabajo.

examples.text: Con el nuevo sueldo puedo ahorrar un poco más cada mes.
examples.translation: With the new salary I can save a little more each month.
examples.emotion: optimistic and pleased about financial progress
